##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 05 May 2026 at 4:30am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, with shallow area of low pressure near Scotland, driving a weak cold front across the area.


##Wind##

North or northwest 2 to 4, increasing force 5 in places this afternoon, then veering east or northeast 4 or 5 in the evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight occasionally moderate in the west later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, veering south or southeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, falling smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
